MOD_SETTINGS.TITLE: Cute Sakiko Mod Settings
MOD_SETTINGS.EGG_TOGGLE.LABEL: Egg Card
MOD_SETTINGS.EGG_TOGGLE.DESC: Automatically obtain the Egg Relic at the start of the game
MOD_SETTINGS.MONSTER_TOGGLE.LABEL: Enable Mod Monsters
MOD_SETTINGS.MONSTER_TOGGLE.DESC: If enabled, custom monsters and encounters from the mod will appear naturally
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BGM_VOLUME.LABEL: Mod's BGM Volume
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_BGM_VOLUME.DESC: Control the volume of mod's BGM. Final volume = Master Volume × this value.
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_SFX_VOLUME.LABEL: Mod's SFX Volume
MOD_SETTINGS.MOD_SFX_VOLUME.DESC: Control the volume of mod's sound effects. Final volume = Master Volume × SFX Volume × this value.
MOD_SETTINGS.AUDIO_TOGGLE.LABEL: Enable Mod Audio
MOD_SETTINGS.AUDIO_TOGGLE.DESC: If disabled, all mod audio playback (SFX and BGM) will be skipped entirely, which can help prevent audio-related crashes.
